name: Zebulun
description: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea, and he shall be for an haven of ships: that's talking about Panama, the Panama Canal. When you read 2 Esdras 13, the ten tribes came over to this side of the world; this identifies them.

note.label: Judgement! To Hell with Your Reparations!

points: Zebulun is the so-called Mayan Indians today, from Guatemala down to Panama. Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea, and he shall be for an haven of ships: the Panama Canal sits in his land, built to shorten the trip around the world, and the ships of the earth must come through and dock there.
His border shall be unto Zidon: as Zebulun dwelt by the sea in ancient Israel, so he dwells by the sea now; it was going to be the same, nothing different.

note.label: Genesis 49: What Shall Befall the Twelve Tribes in the Last Days

points: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali were to stand upon mount Ebal to curse. Half the tribes stood on one side and half on the other, one saying one thing and the other answering.

note.label: Deuteronomy 27: Write the Law upon Stones

points: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents. Notice the grouping: Zebulun and Issachar are blessed together because they would dwell very close, with linked cities at their borders.

note.label: Deuteronomy 33: The Blessing of Moses, Identifying the Tribes in the Last Days

points: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families, and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid, twelve cities with their villages.

Zebulun sat north, together with Issachar and Asher; those three tribes would always reside together, just like today, and Naphtali stayed close to Asher. The same way, Reuben and Gad were always together on the map.

note.label: Joshua 19: The Portions of the Remaining Tribes

points: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali; their coast reached to Zebulun on the south side, to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising, meaning the east.

note.label: Joshua 19: The Portions of the Remaining Tribes

points: She calls Barak the son of Abinoam and gives him the commandment of the Most High: draw toward mount Tabor with ten thousand men of Naphtali and Zebulun, and I will draw unto thee Sisera with his chariots and his multitude to the river Kishon, and deliver him into thine hand.

note.label: Judges 4: Deborah, Barak, and Jael

points: The song rehearses which tribes came out. Out of Ephraim, Benjamin, Machir, and Zebulun came governors and they that handle the pen of the writer, and the princes of Issachar were with Deborah and Barak in the valley.

note.label: Judges 5: The Song of Deborah and Barak: A Willing People

points: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field; those tribes are warriors.

note.label: Judges 5: The Song of Deborah and Barak: A Willing People

points: Those tribes are warriors; do not get it twisted. You see how Zebulun and Naphtali, who are in the south Americas right now, get down: that warrior spirit is still in them, only right now it has turned on each other, and the Most High is going to correct it and turn it right again.

note.label: Judges 6: The Call of Gideon: Why Is All This Befallen Us

points: After him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel ten years; and Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.

note.label: Judges 12: Strife Amongst Brethren

points: The twelve sons of Israel are set down: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 2: The Sons of Israel and the Line of Judah

points: Of Zebulun, fifty thousand went forth to battle, expert in war with all instruments of war, which could keep rank, and were not of a double heart.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 12: The Tribes Gather to David

points: The posts pass from city to city through Ephraim and Manasseh to Zebulun, but the people laugh them to scorn and mock them, the same mockery Israel meets today when the truth is preached.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 30: The Great Passover

points: Many of Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar and Zebulun had not cleansed themselves, yet they ate the Passover.

note.label: The Dividing Hatred: Cornelius the Centurion

points: Many of Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun eat the Passover otherwise than it was written, but Hezekiah prays that the good Lord pardon everyone who prepares his heart to seek God, and the Lord hearkens and heals the people. Grace and mercy are present here in the Old Testament.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 30: The Great Passover

points: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun and the princes of Naphtali. These are the tribes of Israel, the sons of Jacob whose name was changed to Israel.

note.label: Psalm 68: Let God Arise

points: Zebulun, Naphtali and Galilee of the nations walked in darkness and saw a great light. Unto us a child is born, the mighty God and Prince of Peace, who ends the hatred between the two houses.

note.label: The Dividing Hatred: Cornelius the Centurion

points: Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun. He lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun. And the land of Naphtali. And the land of Naphtali.
Zebulun and Naphtali were living in Galilee and were called Gentiles.

note.label: Israel Called Gentiles, Strangers, Heathen & Saints

points: The dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and Naphtali, and afterward more grievously afflicted her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.

note.label: Isaiah 9: For Unto Us a Child Is Born

points: Now you had some Israelites that came back to the land. Watch what they were calling some of the kingdom of Israel: the land of Zabulon and the land of Nephthalim, Galilee of the Gentiles. They were calling them Gentiles.

note.label: Raising Up the Tabernacle of David That Fell

points: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles.

note.label: Acts 10 Reloaded: Call No Man Common

points: The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, Galilee of the Gentiles: the Bible calls two tribes of Israel Gentiles, so the word is not another race.

note.label: The Fallacy of Black Christians

points: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles.
What land is this? It said the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali. Galilee of the Gentiles. Who was called Gentiles in this verse? Zebulun and Naphtali. They were called Gentiles here.

note.label: Israel Called Gentiles, Strangers, Heathen & Saints

points: The scripture calls that country Galilee of the Gentiles. Zebulun and Nephthalim are tribes of the northern kingdom, and this is the key to who the gentiles are that the gospel goes to after the southern kingdom rejects it.

note.label: Matthew 4: The Temptation in the Wilderness and the Calling of the Fishers

points: “Of the tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand”: from Guatemala down towards Panama, the Mayans. “Of the tribe of Joseph”: people get simple and say it says Joseph, not Ephraim, but Joseph makes reference to Ephraim. “Of the tribe of Benjamin”: the so-called West Indians, Jamaica, Trinidad, the Bahamas. We never taught that the twelve tribes are only in the Western Hemisphere; that is a narrative they are trying to put out there.
